adjudication: The taught vampire giant-bat form follows animal battle-form casting restrictions, as requested. Polymorph alone is not a blanket casting ban; explicit native BattleForm.canCast exceptions are honored.
changes: Shared AI and manual spellcasting restrictions for taught bat/mist, native battle forms and Vapor Form
Disable casting before AI forecasts and reject stale executions before resources are consumed
A form change during the casting reaction window prevents completion while retaining committed resources
Manual entry casting, actual spell-card use, spell attack checks and the vampire Dominate ability card use the same restriction
Card browsing, compulsory saves, ordinary polymorph disguises and explicit casting exceptions remain available

records.restriction: Vampire giant-bat form cannot cast spells; return to vampire form first.

limits: This patch covers spellcasting eligibility, not every polymorph counteract/replacement, speech, equipment or bespoke prose exception.
No live casts, resource refunds or form changes were made during diagnostics.
